Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class DoNotDisturb

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.DoNotDisturb
public final class DoNotDisturb extends Object
The desktop's Do Not Disturb state: whether transient notification toasts are being suppressed, optionally only until a deadline.

Suppressing DND never drops a notification from the log — the NotificationModel still records it so the tray/history stays complete; only the popup toast is gated (see Desktop2D.raiseNotification(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.Notification.Kind)). Notification.Kind.ERROR is always allowed through, so a genuine failure surfaces even while DND is on.

Time is never read here — every time-sensitive method takes the current epoch milliseconds — so expiry is deterministic and unit-testable headless. Pure state and listeners (no Swing, no Java 3D).

      public DoNotDisturb()

    • DoNotDisturb

      public DoNotDisturb(boolean enabled, long untilMillis)
      Restores a persisted state. A deadline already in the past is treated as expired, so DND comes back off rather than stuck on.
      Parameters:
      enabled - whether DND was on
      untilMillis - the absolute deadline (0 = indefinite); only meaningful when enabled
